description: The universal RUTHVEN asset record: identity, tokenization, provenance, source works, components, construction sequence, hashes, documents, rights, verified / contextual / inferred facts, unknowns, and counts. Claims carry evidence ids; pass include_evidence=true for the full evidence records as well (large).

asset_id.description: The asset: "PT-0001", a RUTHVEN ID such as "RUTHVEN-PT-0000001", or a work number such as "1".

include_evidence.description: Include every evidence record and the evidence graph. Default false.

name: ruthven_get_asset
title: Get asset record
